$comment: PLACEHOLDER RECORDS — the work table. Stands in for GET /api/v1/admin/team/work (list, scoped and filtered server-side) and GET /api/v1/admin/team/work/{id}. ONE TABLE FOR THREE THINGS: `kind` is task | milestone | target and `parentId` is a self-reference capped at depth 3 (target ▸ milestone ▸ task). Three tables would produce three lists, three status vocabularies, three calendar feeds and three places to look for what a person is doing — and the relationship between them is containment, which is a self-reference and not a join table. `status` is one of five and `delayed` is NOT among them: it is `dueDate < today AND status not terminal`, derived at read, because storing it needs a sweep job and this backend has no queue. `progressPct` is likewise DERIVED for milestones (completed children ÷ total children) and accumulated for targets (currentValue ÷ targetValue) — it is stored on neither, and a milestone whose children disagree with a typed percentage is the bug this prevents.
